Delegates business logic to StaffService and manages request/response flow with proper HTTP status codes and location headers.

Lists all staff members associated with a specific facility ID, accessible to both MANAGER and STAFF roles, and returns a list of staff responses with 200 OK status.
Deactivates a staff member by ID with MANAGER role authorization in an idempotent manner, returning 200 OK status even if the staff is already inactive.
